purpose: Input to a clean-room Banana Q2 implementation; contains only declarative math, operation-order requirements, wire rules, and sealed trace identities. It contains no comparator source text.
forbidden_inputs: copied or mechanically translated comparator code
candidate or archived comparator packed codes as assignment inputs

parent_equivalence.rule: Duplicate Banana child classes are initialized to exact FP16 parent values.

operation_contract.requirement: Use original source weights only and preserve declared orientation before transformation.
Seed once with 36, draw the full input-sign vector, then continue the same RNG stream for the output-sign vector without reseeding. Each sign is sign(sign(randn)+1e-5).

Apply output RMS/sign normalization, normalized 128-point Hadamard, input RMS/sign normalization with the declared parent-codebook scale, the second normalized Hadamard, and one deterministic global-scale search in that order. Materialize SUH as divide-in-FP32 then cast to FP16; materialize SVH as FP16.

Accumulate ordered sample batches with in-place addmm boundaries, divide exactly once by total mass/count, add sigma times the diagonal mean to the scalar diagonal, then apply input signs and the two normalized Hadamard transforms in the declared order.

Compute Cholesky, force the factor through the original contiguous H storage, normalize 16-column blocks serially by their diagonal-block inverses, write exact identity into every 16x16 diagonal block, then clear the scalar diagonal. The factor must be block-lower-triangular.

Visit 128-row buffers from high rows to low rows and, inside each buffer, visit 16-row targets from high rows to low rows. For target slice i, form local_error = W[right]-Q[right], mutate the live persistent product-cache slice with addmm(L_local^T, local_error), then target = W[i] + that live slice.
After all eight targets in a 128-row buffer, update the full persistent product cache in place with addmm(L_buffer^T, W_buffer-Q_buffer). No detached compensation clones are allowed.

operation_contract.dtype: float16 cost/delta/state values; uint8 backpointer branches; uint16 reconstructed states
operation_contract.requirement: Materialize targets to FP16, run a 256-position open pass with roll 128 and strict-less predecessor updates, choose the historical terminal plane/order defined by the sealed trace, recover the start edge, run the constrained pass with roll 0, and backtrack one closed cycle. Equal-cost updates preserve the earlier branch/order.

Pack the cyclic two-bit branch stream MSB-first into 64 bytes per 256-position tile with the canonical four-branch pre-roll alignment. Decode through the procedural 1024-class mapping and the one shared FP16 LUT.

operation_contract.dtype: FP16 scale tensors with float32 working decode and BF16 reported wire output
operation_contract.requirement: Product identity uses the authentic packed-FP16 runtime scale domain. The pre-pack FP32-scale return tensor is a separate diagnostic domain and must never be substituted as the packed-wire target.
